title: How Billionaires Buy Their Own Death Certificates
hook: A loophole in international law allows the ultra-rich to legally declare themselves dead while still breathing—and collect their own life insurance tax-free.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer audacity of faking your own death legally to avoid taxes is a mind-bending concept that demands clicks and shares.

title: The Offshore Vault That Trades in Human Life Spans
hook: Inside a bunker on an unmarked island, brokers trade contracts tied to the lifespans of strangers—sold to the highest bidder.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combining the taboo of betting on death with secret offshore vaults taps into deep fear and fascination.

title: The Algorithm That Scores Your 'Tax Evasion Potential'
hook: A private AI system rates every person on Earth on how easily they could hide money—and sells the data to governments and criminals alike.
why_this_can_go_viral: The Orwellian concept of a universal financial surveillance score triggers outrage and curiosity about personal vulnerability.

title: The Trust Fund That Requires You to Never Marry

why_this_can_go_viral: The extreme personal sacrifice for wealth is a powerful emotional hook that sparks debate and sharing.

title: The Psychiatrist Who Charges Billionaires in Secrets

why_this_can_go_viral: The blending of therapy confidentiality with financial manipulation is a shocking, cinematic concept that viewers want to understand.

title: The Hedge Fund That Shorts Entire Countries

why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that a few traders can profit from the suffering of millions is both infuriating and fascinating, driving engagement.

title: The Accountant Who Hid $1B in a Single Art Collection

title: The Algorithm That Sells Access to the Rich—By Their Scent

title: The Broker Who Sold Insurance on Murders

why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate dark taboo—turning murder into a financial instrument—is emotionally explosive and viral by nature.

title: The Dynasty That Stores Gold in a Dormant Volcano

title: The Offshore Bank That Buries Money in the Desert

why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity of a bank that uses treasure maps as a ledger is universally shareable and visual.

title: The Billionaire Who Bought a Personal Tax Haven in Space
